The provider lists CSV formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These are simulated observations without faults or cyberattacks. The description does not establish the time step or period. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
